standing: DISPOSABLE POSTGRESQL WITNESS ONLY; not production, backup erasure, scheduled cleanup, or member use

checks.name: fresh disposable database verified; candidate schema applied only there
an opportunity does not fabricate a report or consent
two independently blocked claim updates resolve to one report and one recovery
database supplies exactly thirty-day retention, not client time
retry recovers the same identity and never extends retention
changed-payload retry cannot rewrite a report
foreign read and withdrawal disclose nothing and leave own report intact
a second opportunity cannot duplicate a held report; its failed claim rolls back
database rejects report updates, including retention renewal
withdrawal removes active-table content and consumed-opportunity replay cannot resurrect it
withdrawn report also stays absent once its opportunity is no longer held
expired report is excluded even before cleanup runs
expired opportunity cannot authorize a report
cleanup removes only expired active-table rows
failure between claim and insertion rolls both back; later deliberate retry works
member deletion cascades to candidate reports and opportunities
distinct concurrent opportunities cannot duplicate one active member-policy report
receipt is categorical and owner-scoped; it carries no private work
